# Janhavi Dhote

Georgia Tech Computer Engineering student building across software systems, AI, embedded computing, networking, hardware, and security.

## Focus areas

- Computer engineering
- Distributed systems, cloud, and computer networks
- Embedded systems and hardware-software integration
- FPGA and digital design
- AI and computer vision
- Databases, software-defined radio, robotics, and security

## Selected work

- [CuraLink](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/curalink): In-the-moment visual and voice assistance for people with Alzheimer’s, with caregiver oversight.
- [Office Hours Queue & TA Kiosk](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/office-hours-kiosk): A Raspberry Pi check-in, staffing, and student queue system for engineering office hours.
- [GreenBuy](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/greenbuy): Neighborhood-scale collective purchasing for sustainability upgrades.
- [Custom Math Unit – FPGA Peripheral](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/fpga-math-unit): A custom FPGA processor peripheral implementing hardware arithmetic and processor communication.
- [Embedded Game System](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/embedded-game): A real-time game engine and 40 × 25 world rendered on constrained Mbed hardware.
- [LifeLens](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/lifelens): Health risk models, conversational assistance, and provider discovery in one prototype.
- [Research Radar](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/research-radar): A local reader for collecting, deduplicating, organizing, and briefing research sources.
- [IntentGuard](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/work/intentguard): Exploring safer intent translation between BCI decoding and AI-driven actions.

## Experience

- [Peer Leader — Georgia Tech ECE](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/ece1100-peer-leader): Peer leadership and engineering-education support through the ECE Peer Leader Fellowship.
- [Undergraduate Teaching Assistant — Georgia Institute of Technology](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/cs4400-uta): Database systems, SQL, relational design and course support.
- [Undergraduate Teaching Assistant — Georgia Institute of Technology](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/ece2035-uta): Programming, debugging and teaching support at the hardware/software boundary.
- [Undergraduate Teaching Assistant — Georgia Institute of Technology](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/cs2340-uta): Supported ~150 students across Java/Android projects, debugging, code review, and object-oriented software design.
- [Project Lead — Roommate Finder — GITMAD · Georgia Institute of Technology Mastering Android Development](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/gitmad-roommate-finder): Co-led a Georgia Tech mobile-development project group building Roommate Finder.
- [Ground Operations Engineer — Small Satellite Research Laboratory · University of Georgia](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/small-satellite-research-lab): Debugged Linux/GNU Radio SDR pipelines and built low-level C/libpng image encoding and decoding systems using pixel-level manipulation and bit-level payload reconstruction.
- [Assistant Teacher — Double Helix STEAM School](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/double-helix): Prepared weekly financial-news material and helped students connect market trends, earnings, and upcoming events to investing strategy.
- [AI / Software Development — Work-Based Learning — InpharmD](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/inpharmd): Worked on the patient-facing frontend and cloud integration of a healthcare language-model application through a work-based-learning placement.
- [Software Development — Work-Based Learning — Digitivy Solutions](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/digitivy): Worked across React interfaces, Node.js backend APIs, database-backed application flows, and AWS deployment workflows.
- [Robotics Programmer / Subsystems Programmer — Techno Titans Robotics](https://j-anhavi.github.io/Janhavi-Personal-Portfolio/experience/techno-titans): Built Java/WPILib drivetrain software and hardware/software testbeds. Mentored ~20 programmers on debugging and subsystem design.
